news.title: Chinese and US risks mean EU chip sector faces a 'bleak future,' report says
news.summary: Chinese export controls, dependence on the U.S. for technology and the structural weakness of Europe's domestic ‌chip industry mean it faces a "bleak future," an EU-funded report found ‌on Thursday.  The independent report by the European Union's Institute for Security Studies and French think-tank ​Institut Montaigne concluded that Chinese export controls on critical minerals and magnets or the risk of a war in the Taiwan Strait were major threats to supply.  Further vulnerability stems from the EU's dependence on the U.S. for technology, including ‌design software and the possibility ⁠the U.S. could block exports to China by chip-making equipment supplier ASML, Europe's most valuable company.
